                                  Just cause -> throwIO cause
                                  Nothing -> pure (Right result)
                        pure (either (Left . OperationProcessRefused) id native)
  attempted <- try $ Kernel.withOperationProcessSlot parent role $ \token -> Right <$> run token
  case attempted of
    Left (_ :: IOException) -> pure (Left (OperationProcessRefused OwnedSubprocessIoRefused))
    Right (Right result) -> pure result
    Right (Left cause) -> do
      primary <- readIORef primaryFailure
      pure
        ( Left
            ( maybe
                (OperationScopeRefused cause)
                (\failure -> OperationPrimaryAndCleanupRefused failure (OperationScopeRefused cause))
                primary
            )
        )

missingEnvironment :: Subprocess -> Bool
missingEnvironment spec = case subprocessEnvironment spec of
  Nothing -> True
  Just _ -> False

tryOperationAction :: IO value -> IO (Either SomeException value)
tryOperationAction = try

combineOperationProcessResult
  :: Either OperationSubprocessError value
  -> Either OperationSubprocessError ()
  -> Either OperationSubprocessError value
combineOperationProcessResult primary cleanup = case (primary, cleanup) of
  (Left cause, Left refusal) -> Left (OperationPrimaryAndCleanupRefused cause refusal)
  (Left cause, Right ()) -> Left cause
  (Right _, Left cause) -> Left cause
  (Right value, Right ()) -> Right value

-- One bounded allocation per reader, plus at most its bounded trimmed copy.
-- Fragmentation cannot retain an input-shaped list of tiny chunks.
readOperationStream :: Int -> Handle -> IO OwnedStreamResult
readOperationStream maximumBytes handle = readOperationStreamObserved maximumBytes handle Nothing

readOperationStreamObserved
  :: Int
  -> Handle
  -> Maybe (Startup.StartupLineExpectation, IORef Startup.StartupLineStatus)
  -> IO OwnedStreamResult
readOperationStreamObserved maximumBytes handle startup = do
  let publish status = forMStartup (\(_, observed) -> atomicWriteIORef observed status)
      forMStartup action = maybe (pure ()) action startup
  result <- try $ ByteStringInternal.createAndTrim (maximumBytes + 1) $ \buffer ->
    let feed matcher offset count = case matcher of
          Nothing -> pure Nothing
          Just initial -> do
            let advance index current
                  | index >= count || Startup.startupLineStatus current /= Startup.StartupLinePending = pure current
                  | otherwise = do
                      byte <- peekElemOff buffer (offset + index)
                      advance (index + 1) (Startup.feedStartupLineByte current byte)
            current <- advance 0 initial
            publish (Startup.startupLineStatus current)
            pure (Just current)
        loop size matcher
          | size == maximumBytes + 1 = pure size
          | otherwise = do
              count <- hGetBufSome handle (buffer `plusPtr` size) (min 4096 (maximumBytes + 1 - size))
              if count == 0
                then do
                  maybe (pure ()) (publish . Startup.finishStartupLine) matcher
                  pure size
                else do
                  next <- feed matcher size count
                  loop (size + count) next
     in loop 0 (Startup.beginStartupLine . fst <$> startup)
  case result of
    Left (_ :: IOException) -> publish Startup.StartupLineReadFailed >> pure StreamFailed
    Right bytes
      | ByteString.length bytes > maximumBytes ->
          publish Startup.StartupLineExceeded >> pure StreamExceeded
      | otherwise -> pure (StreamBytes bytes)

data ChildOwnership = StandaloneChildOwnership | HostChildOwnership !Kernel.HostPlacementUse

captureOwnedSubprocess
  :: OwnedSubprocessLimits -> Subprocess -> IO (Either OwnedSubprocessError ProcessOutput)
captureOwnedSubprocess limits spec = mask $ \restore -> do
  started <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
  capabilities <- getNumCapabilities
  let endInteger = toInteger started + toInteger (totalMicros limits) * 1000
  if endInteger > toInteger (maxBound :: Word64)
    then pure (Left OwnedSubprocessInvalidLimits)
    else
      if capabilities /= 1
        then pure (Left OwnedSubprocessRuntimeUnsupported)
        else
          if ownedSpecHasNul spec
            then pure (Left OwnedSubprocessStartFailed)
            else do
              let end = fromInteger endInteger
                  stopEnd = end - fromIntegral (settlementMicros limits) * 1000
                  hardEnd = stopEnd - fromIntegral (confirmationMicros limits) * 1000
                  workEnd = hardEnd - fromIntegral (graceMicros limits) * 1000
                  deadlines = OwnedDeadlines workEnd hardEnd stopEnd
                  creationEnd = started + (workEnd - started) `div` 2
              attempted <- try $ do
                executable <- encodeOwnedExec spec
                family <- Family.newScopeFamilyIntent hardEnd stopEnd
                case family of
                  Left _ -> pure (Left OwnedSubprocessDeadlineReached)
                  Right intent -> withOwnedNativeChild deadlines executable $ \child ->
                    withAsync (readOwnedStream (stdoutCeiling limits) (nativeOut child)) $ \out ->
                      withAsync (readOwnedStream (stderrCeiling limits) (nativeErr child)) $ \err -> do
                        uid <- getEffectiveUserID
                        managed <- Bus.withSystemdBus stopEnd ("/run/user/" <> show uid <> "/bus") $ \connection -> lift $ do
                          let noGoCleanup = uninterruptibleMask_ (stopUnadmittedChild deadlines connection intent child)
                              admitted =
                                ownKernelChild
                                  StandaloneChildOwnership
                                  restore
                                  limits
                                  deadlines
                                  creationEnd
                                  connection
                                  intent
                                  child
                                  out
                                  err
                          admitted `onException` void noGoCleanup
                        result <- case managed of
                          Left _ -> do
                            stopped <- uninterruptibleMask_ (stopNativeLeader stopEnd child)
                            pure (stopped >> Left OwnedSubprocessManagerRefused)
                          Right value -> pure value
                        -- Kernel membership and every auxiliary unit settle before readers.
                        streams <- restore (settleOwned end out err)
                        pure $ do
                          exit <- result
                          (stdoutBytes, stderrBytes) <- streams
                          Right (ProcessOutput exit (ByteStringChar8.unpack stdoutBytes) (ByteStringChar8.unpack stderrBytes))
              finished <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
              pure $
                if finished >= fromInteger endInteger
                  then Left OwnedSubprocessDeadlineReached
                  else
                    either
                      (const (Left OwnedSubprocessIoRefused))
                      id
                      (attempted :: Either IOException (Either OwnedSubprocessError ProcessOutput))

-- Encode all filesystem-facing values before fork. executeFile retains the
-- parent's PATH search behavior while the child receives the declared env.
encodeOwnedExec :: Subprocess -> IO OwnedExec
encodeOwnedExec spec = do
  environment <- maybe getEnvironment pure (subprocessEnvironment spec)
  encoding <- getFileSystemEncoding
  let encode value = GHCForeign.withCStringLen encoding value ByteString.packCStringLen
  OwnedExec
    <$> encode (subprocessPath spec)
    <*> traverse encode (subprocessArguments spec)
    <*> traverse encode (subprocessWorkingDirectory spec)
    <*> traverse (\(key, value) -> (,) <$> encode key <*> encode value) environment

ownedSpecHasNul :: Subprocess -> Bool
ownedSpecHasNul spec =
  any (elem '\0') $
    subprocessPath spec
      : subprocessArguments spec
        <> maybe [] pure (subprocessWorkingDirectory spec)
        <> concatMap (\(key, value) -> [key, value]) (maybe [] id (subprocessEnvironment spec))

-- Every descriptor starts CLOEXEC and above stdio. The parent owns a closing
-- registry so a closed numeric descriptor can never be closed again after reuse.
withOwnedNativeChild
  :: OwnedDeadlines
  -> OwnedExec
  -> (OwnedNativeChild -> IO (Either OwnedSubprocessError value))
  -> IO (Either OwnedSubprocessError value)
withOwnedNativeChild deadlines executable action = do
  descriptors <- newIORef []
  let register fd = modifyIORef' descriptors (fd :) >> pure fd
      close fd = do
        held <- atomicModifyIORef' descriptors (\fds -> (filter (/= fd) fds, fd `elem` fds))
        when held (PosixIO.closeFd fd)
      release = readIORef descriptors >>= mapM_ (\fd -> void (try (close fd) :: IO (Either IOException ())))
      above fd@(Fd raw)
        | raw >= 3 = pure fd
        | otherwise = do
            duplicate <-
              Fd <$> throwErrnoIfMinus1Retry "owned stdio duplicate" (ownedDuplicate raw ownedDuplicateCommand 3)
            registered <- register duplicate
            close fd
            pure registered
      pair = allocaArray 2 $ \pointer -> do
        throwErrnoIfMinus1_ "owned pipe" (ownedPipe pointer ownedCloseOnExec)
        first <- peekElemOff pointer 0
        second <- peekElemOff pointer 1
        a <- register (Fd first)
        b <- register (Fd second)
        (,) <$> above a <*> above b
  flip finally release $ do
    (outRead, outWrite) <- pair
    (errRead, errWrite) <- pair
    (execRead, execWrite) <- pair
    (goRead, goWrite) <- pair
    PosixIO.setFdOption goRead PosixIO.NonBlockingRead True
    PosixIO.setFdOption execRead PosixIO.NonBlockingRead True
    input <-
      PosixIO.openFd "/dev/null" PosixIO.ReadOnly PosixIO.defaultFileFlags {PosixIO.cloexec = True}
        >>= register
        >>= above
    owner <- PosixProcess.getProcessID
    now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
    if now >= ownedWorkEnd deadlines
      then pure (Left OwnedSubprocessDeadlineReached)
      else do
        child <-
          PosixProcess.forkProcess $
            trustedOwnedChild
              (ownedWorkEnd deadlines)
              owner
              executable
              input
              outRead
              outWrite
              errRead
              errWrite
              execRead
              execWrite
              goRead
              goWrite
        status <- newIORef Nothing
        ownedDescriptor <- newIORef Nothing
        let await = awaitNativeStatus (ownedStopEnd deadlines) child status
            stop = uninterruptibleMask_ $ do
              void (try (close goWrite) :: IO (Either IOException ()))
              known <- readIORef ownedDescriptor
              case known of
                Nothing -> pure ()
                Just descriptor -> void (ownedPidfdSignal descriptor 9 nullPtr 0)
              void await
        flip finally stop $ do
          mapM_ close [input, outWrite, errWrite, execWrite, goRead]
          descriptor <- ownedPidfdOpen (fromIntegral child) 0
          if descriptor < 0
            then do
              close goWrite
              stopped <- await
              pure
                (maybe (Left OwnedSubprocessLeaderStopUnconfirmed) (const (Left OwnedSubprocessStartFailed)) stopped)
            else do
              pidfd <- register (Fd descriptor)
              writeIORef ownedDescriptor (Just descriptor)
              output <- PosixIO.fdToHandle outRead
              modifyIORef' descriptors (filter (/= outRead))
              flip finally (closeOwnedHandle output) $ do
                errors <- PosixIO.fdToHandle errRead
                modifyIORef' descriptors (filter (/= errRead))
                flip finally (closeOwnedHandle errors) $
                  action (OwnedNativeChild child pidfd goWrite execRead output errors status)

trustedOwnedChild
  :: Word64
  -> ProcessID
  -> OwnedExec
  -> Fd
  -> Fd
  -> Fd
  -> Fd
  -> Fd
  -> Fd
  -> Fd
  -> Fd
  -> Fd
  -> IO ()
trustedOwnedChild
  deadline
  owner
  (OwnedExec path arguments directory environment)
  input
  outRead
  outWrite
  errRead
  errWrite
  execRead
  execWrite
  goRead
  goWrite = do
    mapM_ PosixIO.closeFd [outRead, errRead, execRead, goWrite]
    attempted <- try $ do
      result <- ownedParentDeathSignal ownedParentDeathOption 9 0 0 0
      actual <- PosixProcess.getParentProcessID
      unless (result == 0 && actual == owner) (ioError (userError "owned parent unavailable"))
      token <- readOwnedGate deadline goRead
      now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
      unless (token && now < deadline) (ioError (userError "owned effect gate refused"))
      PosixIO.closeFd goRead
      void PosixProcess.createSession
      void (PosixIO.dupTo input PosixIO.stdInput)
      void (PosixIO.dupTo outWrite PosixIO.stdOutput)
      void (PosixIO.dupTo errWrite PosixIO.stdError)
      mapM_ PosixIO.closeFd [input, outWrite, errWrite]
      maybe (pure ()) PosixDirectory.changeWorkingDirectory directory
      beforeExec <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
      unless (beforeExec < deadline) (ioError (userError "owned exec deadline reached"))
      PosixExec.executeFile path True arguments (Just environment)
    case attempted :: Either IOException () of
      Left _ -> void (try (PosixIO.fdWrite execWrite "E") :: IO (Either IOException PosixTypes.ByteCount))
      Right () -> pure ()
    PosixProcess.exitImmediately (ExitFailure 125)

readOwnedGate :: Word64 -> Fd -> IO Bool
readOwnedGate deadline descriptor = do
  now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
  if now >= deadline
    then pure False
    else do
      token <- try (PosixBytes.fdRead descriptor 1)
      case token of
        Left cause
          | fmap Errno (ioe_errno cause) == Just eAGAIN ->
              threadDelay 1000 >> readOwnedGate deadline descriptor
        Left _ -> pure False
        Right bytes -> pure (bytes == "G")

ownKernelChild
  :: ChildOwnership
  -> (IO (Either OwnedSubprocessError ExitCode) -> IO (Either OwnedSubprocessError ExitCode))
  -> OwnedSubprocessLimits
  -> OwnedDeadlines
  -> Word64
  -> Bus.BusConnection
  -> Family.ScopeFamilyIntent
  -> OwnedNativeChild
  -> Async OwnedStreamResult
  -> Async OwnedStreamResult
  -> IO (Either OwnedSubprocessError ExitCode)
ownKernelChild ownership restore limits deadlines creationEnd connection intent child out err = do
  let OwnedSubprocessResourceBounds
        memory
        tasks
        cpu
        helperMemory
        helperTasks
        helperCpu
        helperStart
        helperStop = resourceBounds limits
      scopeLimits =
        Kernel.scopeKernelLimits
          memory
          0
          tasks
          cpu
          (fromIntegral (totalMicros limits))
          (fromIntegral (graceMicros limits))
      helperLimits = Family.expiryHelperLimits helperMemory helperTasks helperCpu helperStart helperStop
  case (scopeLimits, helperLimits) of
    (Just scopeBounds, Just helperBounds) -> do
      let submit = case ownership of
            StandaloneChildOwnership -> Family.startScopeFamily
            HostChildOwnership token -> Family.startHostScopeFamily token
          observe = case ownership of
            StandaloneChildOwnership -> \busConnection ->
              Kernel.withObservedChildScopeBefore busConnection (ownedWorkEnd deadlines) (ownedStopEnd deadlines)
            HostChildOwnership token -> Kernel.withObservedHostChildScope token
      submitted <-
        submit connection creationEnd intent (nativePidfd child) scopeBounds helperBounds
      observed <- observe
        connection
        (nativePidfd child)
        (Family.scopeFamilyUnitName intent Family.FamilyScope)
        scopeBounds
        $ \scope -> do
          let stop = uninterruptibleMask_ (stopKernelChild limits deadlines connection intent child scope)
              run = do
                armed <-
                  familyAlarmReady
                    (Bus.systemdBusWithin (ownedWorkEnd deadlines) connection)
                    intent
                    (ownedHardEnd deadlines)
                placement <- case ownership of
                  StandaloneChildOwnership -> pure (Right ())
                  HostChildOwnership token -> do
                    helper <- Family.verifyHostScopeFamilyBeforeEffect token connection intent helperBounds
                    case helper of
                      Left _ -> pure (Left Kernel.KernelScopeResourceMismatch)
                      Right () -> do
                        parent <- Kernel.verifyHostPlacementBeforeEffect token
                        case parent of
                          Left cause -> pure (Left cause)
                          Right () -> Kernel.verifyKernelScopeBeforeEffect (ownedWorkEnd deadlines) scopeBounds scope
                if not armed || either (const True) (const False) placement
                  then pure (Left OwnedSubprocessFamilyUnconfirmed)
                  else do
                    now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
                    if now >= ownedWorkEnd deadlines
                      then pure (Left OwnedSubprocessDeadlineReached)
                      else do
                        written <- PosixIO.fdWrite (nativeGo child) "G"
                        if written /= 1
                          then pure (Left OwnedSubprocessStartFailed)
                          else do
                            started <- awaitOwnedExec (ownedWorkEnd deadlines) (nativeExec child)
                            case started of
                              Left cause -> pure (Left cause)
                              Right () -> superviseKernelChild (ownedWorkEnd deadlines) child out err
          primary <- restore run `onException` void stop
          stopped <- stop
          pure (Right (stopped >> primary))
      case observed of
        Left _ -> do
          cleanup <- stopUnadmittedChild deadlines connection intent child
          pure
            ( cleanup
                >> Left
                  (either (const OwnedSubprocessManagerRefused) (const OwnedSubprocessScopeUnobservable) submitted)
            )
        Right primary -> do
          closing <- awaitOwnedFamilyAbsent connection intent
          pure (closing >> primary)
    _ -> pure (Left OwnedSubprocessInvalidLimits)

familyAlarmReady :: Bus.BusConnection -> Family.ScopeFamilyIntent -> Word64 -> IO Bool
familyAlarmReady connection intent hard = do
  result <- runExceptT $ do
    inventory <- Family.observeScopeFamily connection intent
    timer <-
      Bus.callManager
        connection
        Bus.GetUnit
        (\message -> Bus.appendString message (Family.scopeFamilyUnitName intent Family.FamilyTimer))
        (`Bus.readString` 'o')
    let property interface name = Bus.callManager connection (Bus.ReadUnitProperty timer) $ \message ->
          Bus.appendString message interface >> Bus.appendString message name
    expiry <- property "org.freedesktop.systemd1.Timer" "NextElapseUSecMonotonic" Bus.readVariantWord64
    state <- property "org.freedesktop.systemd1.Unit" "ActiveState" Bus.readVariantString
    pure (inventory, expiry, state)
  pure $ case result of
    Right (inventory, expiry, "active") ->
      expiry == hard `div` 1000
        && case ( Family.scopeFamilyPresence inventory Family.FamilyTimer
                , Family.scopeFamilyPresence inventory Family.FamilyExpiry
                ) of
          ( Family.ScopeFamilyUnitPresent (Bus.InvocationPresent _)
            , Family.ScopeFamilyUnitPresent Bus.InvocationAbsent
            ) -> True
          _ -> False
    _ -> False

awaitOwnedExec :: Word64 -> Fd -> IO (Either OwnedSubprocessError ())
awaitOwnedExec deadline descriptor = do
  now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
  if now >= deadline
    then pure (Left OwnedSubprocessDeadlineReached)
    else do
      result <- try (PosixBytes.fdRead descriptor 1)
      case result of
        Left cause | isEOFError cause -> pure (Right ())
        Left cause
          | fmap Errno (ioe_errno cause) == Just eAGAIN ->
              threadDelay 1000 >> awaitOwnedExec deadline descriptor
        Left _ -> pure (Left OwnedSubprocessStartFailed)
        Right bytes -> pure (if ByteString.null bytes then Right () else Left OwnedSubprocessStartFailed)

superviseKernelChild
  :: Word64
  -> OwnedNativeChild
  -> Async OwnedStreamResult
  -> Async OwnedStreamResult
  -> IO (Either OwnedSubprocessError ExitCode)
superviseKernelChild deadline child out err = do
  outState <- ownedStreamFailure OwnedSubprocessStdoutExceeded <$> poll out
  errState <- ownedStreamFailure OwnedSubprocessStderrExceeded <$> poll err
  exited <- pollNativeStatus (nativePid child) (nativeStatus child)
  now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
  case outState >> errState of
    Left cause -> pure (Left cause)
    Right ()
      | now >= deadline -> pure (Left OwnedSubprocessDeadlineReached)
      | Just status <- exited -> pure (Right (nativeExitCode status))
      | otherwise -> threadDelay 1000 >> superviseKernelChild deadline child out err

ownedStreamFailure
  :: OwnedSubprocessError -> Maybe (Either exception OwnedStreamResult) -> Either OwnedSubprocessError ()
ownedStreamFailure exceeded state = case state of
  Just (Left _) -> Left OwnedSubprocessStreamFailed
  Just (Right StreamFailed) -> Left OwnedSubprocessStreamFailed
  Just (Right StreamExceeded) -> Left exceeded
  _ -> Right ()

stopKernelChild
  :: OwnedSubprocessLimits
  -> OwnedDeadlines
  -> Bus.BusConnection
  -> Family.ScopeFamilyIntent
  -> OwnedNativeChild
  -> Kernel.KernelScope
  -> IO (Either OwnedSubprocessError ())
stopKernelChild limits deadlines connection intent child scope = do
  stopped <- stopKernelChildProcesses (fromIntegral (graceMicros limits)) deadlines child scope
  case stopped of
    Left cause -> pure (Left cause)
    Right () -> do
      retired <- Family.retireScopeFamilyAlarms connection (ownedStopEnd deadlines) intent scope
      pure $ case retired of
        Right () -> Right ()
        Left (Family.ScopeFamilyChildRefused _) -> Left OwnedSubprocessAlarmScopeUnobservable
        Left _ -> Left OwnedSubprocessFamilyUnconfirmed

stopKernelChildProcesses
  :: Word64
  -> OwnedDeadlines
  -> OwnedNativeChild
  -> Kernel.KernelScope
  -> IO (Either OwnedSubprocessError ())
stopKernelChildProcesses grace deadlines child scope = do
  now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
  let graceEnd = fromInteger (min (toInteger (ownedHardEnd deadlines)) (toInteger now + toInteger grace * 1000))
  initially <- Kernel.kernelScopeEmpty scope
  graceful <- case initially of
    Right True -> pure True
    Right False -> do
      void (Kernel.terminateKernelScope graceEnd scope)
      awaitKernelEmpty graceEnd scope
    Left _ -> pure False
  unless graceful (void (Kernel.killKernelScope scope))
  empty <- awaitKernelEmpty (ownedStopEnd deadlines) scope
  leader <- awaitNativeStatus (ownedStopEnd deadlines) (nativePid child) (nativeStatus child)
  pure $
    if not empty
      then Left OwnedSubprocessDescendantStopUnconfirmed
      else
        if leader == Nothing
          then Left OwnedSubprocessLeaderStopUnconfirmed
          else Right ()

awaitKernelEmpty :: Word64 -> Kernel.KernelScope -> IO Bool
awaitKernelEmpty deadline scope = do
  observed <- Kernel.observeKernelScopeEmptyBefore deadline scope
  now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
  case observed of
    Right True -> pure (now < deadline)
    Right False | now < deadline -> threadDelay 1000 >> awaitKernelEmpty deadline scope
    _ -> pure False

stopUnadmittedChild
  :: OwnedDeadlines
  -> Bus.BusConnection
  -> Family.ScopeFamilyIntent
  -> OwnedNativeChild
  -> IO (Either OwnedSubprocessError ())
stopUnadmittedChild deadlines connection intent child = do
  leader <- stopNativeLeader (ownedStopEnd deadlines) child
  closing <- awaitOwnedFamilyAbsent connection intent
  pure (leader >> closing)

-- A failed connection never reaches the family callback. Its trusted child
-- still owns the pipe writers, so stop it before waiting for reader EOF.
stopNativeLeader :: Word64 -> OwnedNativeChild -> IO (Either OwnedSubprocessError ())
stopNativeLeader deadline child = do
  let Fd descriptor = nativePidfd child
  void (ownedPidfdSignal descriptor 9 nullPtr 0)
  leader <- awaitNativeStatus deadline (nativePid child) (nativeStatus child)
  pure (maybe (Left OwnedSubprocessLeaderStopUnconfirmed) (const (Right ())) leader)

awaitOwnedFamilyAbsent
  :: Bus.BusConnection -> Family.ScopeFamilyIntent -> IO (Either OwnedSubprocessError ())
awaitOwnedFamilyAbsent connection intent = do
  result <- runExceptT (Family.observeScopeFamily connection intent)
  now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
  case result of
    Right inventory
      | Family.scopeFamilyAbsent inventory && now < Bus.systemdBusDeadline connection -> pure (Right ())
      | now < Bus.systemdBusDeadline connection ->
          threadDelay 1000 >> awaitOwnedFamilyAbsent connection intent
    _ -> pure (Left OwnedSubprocessFamilyUnconfirmed)

pollNativeStatus
  :: ProcessID -> IORef (Maybe PosixProcess.ProcessStatus) -> IO (Maybe PosixProcess.ProcessStatus)
pollNativeStatus child stored = mask_ $ do
  cached <- readIORef stored
  case cached of
    Just _ -> pure cached
    Nothing -> do
      -- Nonblocking waitpid consumption and cache publication are one owned
      -- transition; cancellation must not lose a status already reaped.
      current <- PosixProcess.getProcessStatus False False child
      maybe (pure ()) (writeIORef stored . Just) current
      pure current

awaitNativeStatus
  :: Word64
  -> ProcessID
  -> IORef (Maybe PosixProcess.ProcessStatus)
  -> IO (Maybe PosixProcess.ProcessStatus)
awaitNativeStatus deadline child stored = do
  status <- pollNativeStatus child stored
  now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
  case status of
    Just _ -> pure status
    Nothing
      | now >= deadline -> pure Nothing
      | otherwise -> threadDelay 1000 >> awaitNativeStatus deadline child stored

nativeExitCode :: PosixProcess.ProcessStatus -> ExitCode
nativeExitCode status = case status of
  PosixProcess.Exited code -> code
  PosixProcess.Terminated signal _ -> ExitFailure (negate (fromIntegral signal))
  PosixProcess.Stopped signal -> ExitFailure (negate (fromIntegral signal))

closeOwnedHandle :: Handle -> IO ()
closeOwnedHandle handle = void (try (hClose handle) :: IO (Either IOException ()))

settleOwned
  :: Word64
  -> Async OwnedStreamResult
  -> Async OwnedStreamResult
  -> IO (Either OwnedSubprocessError (ByteString, ByteString))
settleOwned deadline out err = do
  now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
  let remaining = if now >= deadline then 0 else fromIntegral ((deadline - now) `div` 1000)
  streams <- timeout remaining ((,) <$> wait out <*> wait err)
  after <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
  pure $ case streams of
    _ | after >= deadline -> Left OwnedSubprocessDeadlineReached
    Nothing -> Left OwnedSubprocessReadersUnsettled
    Just (stdoutResult, stderrResult) ->
      (,)
        <$> bytes OwnedSubprocessStdoutExceeded stdoutResult
        <*> bytes OwnedSubprocessStderrExceeded stderrResult
 where
  bytes _ (StreamBytes value) = Right value
  bytes exceeded StreamExceeded = Left exceeded
  bytes _ StreamFailed = Left OwnedSubprocessStreamFailed

readOwnedStream :: Int -> Handle -> IO OwnedStreamResult
readOwnedStream maximumBytes handle = loop 0 []
 where
  loop size chunks = do
    -- Read one byte beyond the admitted remaining length to distinguish exact
    -- size from overflow without retaining an unbounded extra chunk.
    next <-
      try (ByteString.hGetSome handle (min 4096 (min 4096 (maximumBytes - size) + 1)))
        :: IO (Either IOException ByteString)
    case next of
      Left _ -> pure StreamFailed
      Right chunk
        | ByteString.null chunk -> pure (StreamBytes (ByteString.concat (reverse chunks)))
        | ByteString.length chunk > maximumBytes - size -> pure StreamExceeded
        | otherwise -> loop (size + ByteString.length chunk) (chunk : chunks)

  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityWorkspaceFailed
  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityKubeconfigFailed !String
  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityPortReservationFailed !String
  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityProcessStartFailed !String
  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityReadinessFailed !String

  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityRequestRefused !ControlPlaneClientError

  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityBootstrapRefused !RpcBirthBootstrapError
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)

renderLocalLifecycleAuthorityError :: LocalLifecycleAuthorityError -> String
renderLocalLifecycleAuthorityError err = case err of
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed cause -> "owned Lifecycle Authority transport: " ++ show cause
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationDeadline -> "owned Lifecycle Authority transport reached its original work deadline"
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityWorkspaceFailed -> "prepare owned Lifecycle Authority kubeconfig workspace"
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityKubeconfigFailed detail ->
    "resolve home Lifecycle Authority kubeconfig: " ++ detail
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityPortReservationFailed detail ->
    "reserve Lifecycle Authority loopback port: " ++ detail
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityProcessStartFailed detail ->
    "start Lifecycle Authority Service port-forward: " ++ detail
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityReadinessFailed detail ->
    "Lifecycle Authority Service is not ready: " ++ detail
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityClientInvalid detail ->
    "construct Lifecycle Authority client: " ++ show detail
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityChannelClosed -> "owned Lifecycle Authority channel is closed"
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityRequestRefused cause -> "owned Lifecycle Authority request: " ++ show cause

      Left detail ->

withOperationLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport

  -> EmbeddedHomeKubeconfig

  -> AuthenticatedTransportBounds
  -> AuthenticatedClientProviders IO
  -> (AuthenticatedClientTransport 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)
withOperationLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport processes config environment bounds providers action =

    config

    (action . operationLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport bounds providers)

-- The client cannot be selected or extracted by callers. Release joins every
-- bounded use before closing the lease; escaped uses subsequently refuse.
-- Neither a channel nor its local lifetime grants Authority admission.
data OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel
  = OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel
      !OperationAuthorityChannelScope
      !(ControlPlaneClient 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime)
      !(ControlPlaneClient 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime)

data OperationAuthorityChannelScope
  = OperationAuthorityChannelScope !OperationTransport !Uses.OperationUses

withOperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel
  :: OperationSubprocesses
  -> EmbeddedHomeKubeconfig
  -> [(String, String)]
  -> (OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)
withOperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel =
  withOperationLifecycleAuthorityChannelUsingMaximum rpcBirthRegistryResponseMaximumBytes

operationLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport
  :: AuthenticatedTransportBounds
  -> AuthenticatedClientProviders IO
  -> OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel
  -> AuthenticatedClientTransport 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime
operationLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport bounds providers (OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel scope client _) =
  mkAuthenticatedClientTransport bounds guarded client
 where
  guarded =
    AuthenticatedClientProviders
      { provideAuthenticatedClientSigner = do
          provided <- guardChannelProvider scope (provideAuthenticatedClientSigner providers)
          pure $ do
            signer <- provided
            first (const "owned Authority channel signer invalid") $
              mkRequestSigningCapability
                (requestSigningCapabilityPrincipal signer)
                (requestSigningCapabilityGeneration signer)
                (requestSigningCapabilityPublicKeyBytes signer)
                ( \bytes ->
                    guardChannelProvider
                      scope
                      (first (Text.pack . show) <$> signCanonicalBytesWithRequestCapability signer bytes)
                )
      , provideAuthenticatedClientScope =
          guardChannelProvider scope (provideAuthenticatedClientScope providers)
      , provideAuthenticatedClientEpoch =
          guardChannelProvider scope (provideAuthenticatedClientEpoch providers)
      , provideAuthenticatedClientDeadline =
          guardChannelProvider scope (provideAuthenticatedClientDeadline providers)
      , provideAuthenticatedClientNonce =
          guardChannelProvider scope (provideAuthenticatedClientNonce providers)
      }

guardChannelProvider
  :: OperationAuthorityChannelScope
  -> IO (Either Text.Text value)
  -> IO (Either Text.Text value)
guardChannelProvider scope action =
  either (Left . Text.pack . renderLocalLifecycleAuthorityError) id
    <$> withOperationAuthorityChannelUse scope action

verifyOperationLifecycleAuthorityChannelBeforeEffect
  :: OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError ())
verifyOperationLifecycleAuthorityChannelBeforeEffect (OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel scope _ _) =
  withOperationAuthorityChannelUse scope (pure ())

requestOperationLifecycleAuthorityOwnBindingHint
  :: OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel
  -> RpcOwnBindingQuery
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError RpcOwnBindingHint)
requestOperationLifecycleAuthorityOwnBindingHint (OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel scope client _) query =
  fmap join $ withOperationAuthorityChannelUse scope $ do
    response <- callControlPlane client LifecycleMigrationApplyRoute (encodeRpcOwnBindingQuery query)
    decoded <- evaluate $ case response of
      Left cause -> Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityRequestRefused cause)
      Right (ControlPlaneResponse status body)
        | status /= 200 -> Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityHintHttpStatus status)
        | otherwise ->
            either (Left . LocalLifecycleAuthorityHintRefused) Right (decodeRpcOwnBindingHint query body)
    case decoded of
      Left cause -> cause `seq` pure (Left cause)
      Right hint -> hint `seq` pure (Right hint)

-- The complete fixed program, including native origin/public/signing effects,
-- holds the same joined borrow. Only registry metadata can leave this method.
requestOperationLifecycleAuthorityBootstrapRegistry
  :: OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel
  -> NativeRpcSigningInterpreter IO
  -> IO (Either Text.Text AuthorityTime)
  -> IO (Either Text.Text RequestNonce)
  -> AuthorityScope
  -> RpcBirthServingMode
  -> AuthorityTime
  -> AuthenticatedTransportBounds
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError RpcBirthRegistryObservation)
requestOperationLifecycleAuthorityBootstrapRegistry (OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel scope _ client) native readTime nonce authority mode deadline bounds = do
  result <-
    withOperationAuthorityChannelUse scope $
      observeRpcBirthBootstrapRegistry native readTime nonce authority mode deadline bounds client
  pure (result >>= first LocalLifecycleAuthorityBootstrapRefused)

-- The shared owner counts nested uses without holding a mutex over effects.
-- This channel selects its exact persistent transport as the observed source.
withOperationAuthorityChannelUse
  :: OperationAuthorityChannelScope
  -> IO value
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)
withOperationAuthorityChannelUse (OperationAuthorityChannelScope _ uses) action =
  first classify <$> Uses.withOperationUse uses action
 where
  classify cause = case cause of
    Uses.OperationUseClosed -> LocalLifecycleAuthorityChannelClosed
    Uses.OperationUseDeadlineReached -> LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationDeadline
    Uses.OperationUseProcessRefused failure -> LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed failure

withOperationLifecycleAuthorityChannelUsingMaximum
  :: Int
  -> OperationSubprocesses
  -> EmbeddedHomeKubeconfig
  -> [(String, String)]
  -> (OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)
withOperationLifecycleAuthorityChannelUsingMaximum maximumBytes processes config environment action = do
  admitted <- verifyOperationSubprocessesBeforeEffect processes
  case admitted of
    Left cause -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed cause))
    Right () -> do
      attempted <- tryOperationClientWorkspace $ do
        directory <-
          createTempDirectory (operationSubprocessRuntimeDirectory processes) "authority-forward-"
        use directory
      pure (either (const (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityWorkspaceFailed)) id attempted)
 where
  use directory = do
    written <- writeEmbeddedHomeKubeconfig directory config
    case written of
      Left _ -> pure (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityWorkspaceFailed)
      Right kubeconfig -> do
        port <- reserveLoopbackPort
        case port of
          Left detail -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityPortReservationFailed detail))
          Right localPort -> do
            let childEnvironment =
                  [ ("HOME", directory)
                  , ("XDG_CACHE_HOME", directory </> "cache")
                  , ("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", directory </> "config")
                  , ("XDG_DATA_HOME", directory </> "data")
                  ]
                    ++ filter (not . privateEnvironmentKey . fst) environment
                spec =
                  Subprocess
                    { subprocessPath = "kubectl"
                    , subprocessArguments =
                        [ "--kubeconfig"
                        , kubeconfig
                        , "--cache-dir"
                        , directory </> "cache"
                        , "--namespace"
                        , lifecycleAuthorityNamespace
                        , "port-forward"
                        , lifecycleAuthorityForwardTarget
                        , show localPort ++ ":" ++ show lifecycleAuthorityRemotePort
                        , "--address"
                        , "127.0.0.1"
                        ]
                    , subprocessEnvironment = Just childEnvironment
                    , subprocessWorkingDirectory = Just directory
                    }
            case Startup.mkStartupLineExpectation
              (map Bytes.pack (Home.homeControlPlaneForwardStartupLines Home.HomeLifecycleAuthority localPort)) of
              Left _ -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityReadinessFailed "startup mapping invalid"))
              Right expected -> do
                forwarded <- withOperationTransportStartup processes spec expected $ \lease -> do
                  ready <- waitOperationAuthorityReady lease localPort
                  case ready of
                    Left cause -> pure (Left cause)
                    Right () -> Uses.withOperationTransportUses lease $ \uses -> do
                      httpGate <- newMVar ()
                      let scope = OperationAuthorityChannelScope lease uses
                          clients =
                            (,)
                              <$> operationAuthorityChannelClient (min 65536 maximumBytes) scope httpGate localPort
                              <*> operationAuthorityChannelClient maximumBytes scope httpGate localPort
                      case clients of
                        Left cause -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityClientInvalid cause))
                        Right (ordinary, registry) ->
                          Right <$> action (OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel scope ordinary registry)
                pure (either (Left . LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed) id forwarded)
  privateEnvironmentKey key =
    forbiddenKubectlEnvironmentKey key
      || key `elem` ["HOME", "XDG_CACHE_HOME", "XDG_CONFIG_HOME", "XDG_DATA_HOME"]

operationAuthorityChannelClient
  :: Int
  -> OperationAuthorityChannelScope
  -> MVar ()
  -> Int
  -> Either ControlPlaneClientError (ControlPlaneClient 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime)
operationAuthorityChannelClient maximumBytes scope@(OperationAuthorityChannelScope lease _) httpGate localPort = do
  endpoint <- mkLifecycleAuthorityEndpoint (Text.pack (loopbackEndpoint localPort))
  controlPlaneClientWithTransport maximumBytes endpoint $ \method headers url body ->
    fmap (either (const refused) id) $
      withOperationAuthorityChannelUse scope $
        withMVar httpGate $ \() -> do
          now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
          let ending = operationTransportWorkEnd lease
          if now >= ending || ending - now < 1000
            then pure expired
            else do
              let micros = fromInteger (min (toInteger (maxBound :: Int)) (toInteger ((ending - now) `div` 1000)))
                  config = HttpConfig (min micros (httpRequestTimeoutMicros lifecycleAuthorityHttpConfig))
              httpRequestRawBounded config maximumBytes method headers url (Just (Lazy.fromStrict body))
 where
  refused = Left (HttpBoundedTransport (HttpConnectionFailure "owned Authority channel refused"))
  expired = Left (HttpBoundedTransport (HttpTimeout "owned Authority channel original work deadline"))

tryOperationClientWorkspace :: IO value -> IO (Either IOException value)
tryOperationClientWorkspace = try

waitOperationAuthorityReady
  :: OperationTransport -> Int -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError ())
waitOperationAuthorityReady lease localPort = acknowledge
 where
  acknowledge = do
    observed <- observeOperationTransportStartup lease
    case observed of
      Left cause -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed cause))
      Right Startup.StartupLineAccepted -> loop
      Right Startup.StartupLinePending -> do
        now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
        if now >= ending || ending - now < 1000
          then pure (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationDeadline)
          else do
            threadDelay (fromInteger (min 25000 ((toInteger ending - toInteger now) `div` 1000)))
            acknowledge
      Right Startup.StartupLineRejected -> refused "startup acknowledgement does not match the compiled loopback mapping"
      Right Startup.StartupLineIncomplete -> refused "startup acknowledgement ended before a complete matching line"
      Right Startup.StartupLineReadFailed -> refused "startup acknowledgement unavailable"
      Right Startup.StartupLineExceeded -> refused "startup stdout exceeded its bound"
      Right Startup.StartupLineUnconfigured -> refused "startup acknowledgement was not configured"
  refused = pure . Left . LocalLifecycleAuthorityReadinessFailed
  ending = operationTransportWorkEnd lease
  endpoint = loopbackEndpoint localPort ++ localClientStartupProbePath LifecycleAuthorityRuntime
  loop = do
    observed <- verifyOperationTransportBeforeEffect lease
    case observed of
      Left cause -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed cause))
      Right () -> do
        now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
        if now >= ending || ending - now < 1000
          then pure (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationDeadline)
          else do
            let allowance = fromInteger (min 1000000 (toInteger ((ending - now) `div` 1000)))
            response <-
              timeout allowance $
                httpRequestRawBounded (HttpConfig allowance) 4096 "GET" [] endpoint Nothing
            after <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
            if after >= ending
              then pure (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationDeadline)
              else case response of
                Just (Right (status, _)) | status >= 200 && status < 300 -> do
                  closing <- verifyOperationTransportBeforeEffect lease
                  pure (either (Left . LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed) (const (Right ())) closing)
                Just (Left (HttpBoundedResponseTooLarge _ _)) ->
                  pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityReadinessFailed "startup response exceeds its 4096-byte bound"))
                _ -> do
                  threadDelay (fromInteger (min 250000 ((toInteger ending - toInteger after) `div` 1000)))
                  loop

-- | Retry the complete disposable Authority Backup port-forward lifecycle.
-- Only listener liveness is pending: setup/client failures are terminal, and
-- the user action is inside a successful attempt so its result is never
-- repeated. 'bracket' retires the current child before the inter-attempt delay.
retryAuthorityBackupForwardWith
  :: Int
  -> IO ()
  -> IO (Either LocalAuthorityBackupError process)
  -> (Either LocalAuthorityBackupError process -> IO ())
  -> (process -> IO (Either LocalAuthorityBackupError value))
  -> IO (Either LocalAuthorityBackupError value)
retryAuthorityBackupForwardWith attemptBudget delay acquire release use =
  go (max 1 attemptBudget)
 where
  go remaining = do
    result <-
      bracket acquire release runStarted
    case result of
      Left err@(LocalAuthorityBackupLivenessFailed _)
        | remaining > 1 -> delay >> go (remaining - 1)
        | otherwise -> pure (Left err)
      _ -> pure result
  runStarted started = case started of
    Left err -> pure (Left err)
    Right process -> use process

waitForAuthorityBackupForwardStartup
  :: Int
  -> BackgroundProcess
  -> IO (Either LocalAuthorityBackupError ())
waitForAuthorityBackupForwardStartup localPort process =
  case backgroundStdoutHandle process of
    Nothing ->
      pure
        ( classifyAuthorityBackupForwardStartup
            localPort
            AuthorityBackupForwardStartupReadFailed
        )
    Just stdoutHandle -> do
      observed <-
        timeout
          authorityBackupForwardStartupTimeoutMicros
          (try (hGetLine stdoutHandle) :: IO (Either IOException String))
      pure
        ( classifyAuthorityBackupForwardStartup
            localPort
            ( case observed of
                Nothing -> AuthorityBackupForwardStartupTimedOut
                Just (Left _) -> AuthorityBackupForwardStartupReadFailed
                Just (Right line) -> AuthorityBackupForwardStartupLine line
            )
        )

classifyAuthorityBackupForwardStartup
  :: Int
  -> AuthorityBackupForwardStartupObservation
  -> Either LocalAuthorityBackupError ()
classifyAuthorityBackupForwardStartup localPort observation =
  case observation of
    AuthorityBackupForwardStartupTimedOut -> refused "startup acknowledgement timed out"
    AuthorityBackupForwardStartupReadFailed -> refused "startup acknowledgement unavailable"
    AuthorityBackupForwardStartupLine line
      | line `elem` expectedLines -> Right ()
      | otherwise -> refused "startup acknowledgement did not match the compiled loopback mapping"
 where
  refused = Left . LocalAuthorityBackupLivenessFailed
  expectedLines = Home.homeControlPlaneForwardStartupLines Home.HomeAuthorityBackup localPort

waitUntilStartupProbe :: RuntimeRole -> Int -> Int -> IO (Either String ())
waitUntilStartupProbe role localPort remaining = do
  result <-
    httpRequestNoBody
      readinessHttpConfig
      "GET"
      []
      (loopbackEndpoint localPort ++ localClientStartupProbePath role)
  case result of
    Right () -> pure (Right ())
    Left err
      | remaining <= 1 -> pure (Left (renderHttpError err))
      | otherwise -> do
          threadDelay 250000
          waitUntilStartupProbe role localPort (remaining - 1)

-- | Authority Backup is contacted during genesis before its S3 credential
-- exists, so that one local client waits only for listener liveness. Every
-- other role retains capability-backed readiness as its startup barrier.
localClientStartupProbePath :: RuntimeRole -> String
localClientStartupProbePath role = case role of
  BootstrapBroker -> "/readyz"
  GatewayRuntime -> "/readyz"
  LifecycleAuthorityRuntime -> Home.homeControlPlaneStartupProbePath Home.HomeLifecycleAuthority
  ProviderWorkerRuntime -> Home.homeControlPlaneStartupProbePath Home.HomeProviderWorker
  AuthorityBackupRuntime -> Home.homeControlPlaneStartupProbePath Home.HomeAuthorityBackup
  TlsRetentionRuntime -> Home.homeControlPlaneStartupProbePath Home.HomeTlsRetention
  TargetSecretAgentRuntime -> Home.homeControlPlaneStartupProbePath Home.HomeTargetSecretAgent

reserveLoopbackPort :: IO (Either String Int)
reserveLoopbackPort = do
  attempted <-
    try
      ( withSocketsDo $
          bracket
            (socket AF_INET Stream defaultProtocol)
            close
            ( \reserved -> do
                setSocketOption reserved ReuseAddr 1
                bind reserved (SockAddrInet 0 (tupleToHostAddress (127, 0, 0, 1)))
                address <- getSocketName reserved
                case address of
                  SockAddrInet port _ -> pure (fromIntegral port)
                  _ -> ioError (userError "reserved socket was not IPv4")
            )
      )
      :: IO (Either IOException Int)
  pure (either (Left . displayException) Right attempted)

-- | Joined, original-bound use of an observed operation parent or transport.
-- The owner closes admission before joining uses. Nested uses hold no mutex
-- across effects; an escaped owner cannot admit work after its scope closes.
module Prodbox.ControlPlane.OperationUse
  ( OperationUses
  , OperationUseError (..)
  , withOperationParentUses
  , withOperationTransportUses
  , withOperationUse
  ) where

import Control.Concurrent.STM (TVar, atomically, check, modifyTVar', newTVarIO, readTVar, writeTVar)
import Control.Exception (evaluate, finally, mask, uninterruptibleMask_)
import Data.Word (Word64)
import GHC.Clock (getMonotonicTimeNSec)
import Numeric.Natural (Natural)
import Prodbox.Subprocess
  ( OperationSubprocessError
  , OperationSubprocesses
  , OperationTransport
  , operationSubprocessWindow
  , operationTransportWorkEnd
  , verifyOperationSubprocessesBeforeEffect
  , verifyOperationTransportBeforeEffect
  )
import Prodbox.Subprocess.SystemdIdentity (hostExecutionWorkEnd)
import System.Timeout (timeout)

data OperationUseSource
  = ParentUses !OperationSubprocesses
  | TransportUses !OperationTransport

data OperationUseState = UsesOpen !Natural | UsesClosing !Natural

data OperationUses = OperationUses !OperationUseSource !(TVar OperationUseState)

data OperationUseError
  = OperationUseClosed
  | OperationUseDeadlineReached
  | OperationUseProcessRefused !OperationSubprocessError
  deriving (Eq, Show)

withOperationParentUses :: OperationSubprocesses -> (OperationUses -> IO value) -> IO value
withOperationParentUses processes = withUses (ParentUses processes)

withOperationTransportUses :: OperationTransport -> (OperationUses -> IO value) -> IO value
withOperationTransportUses lease = withUses (TransportUses lease)

withUses :: OperationUseSource -> (OperationUses -> IO value) -> IO value
withUses source action = do
  uses <- OperationUses source <$> newTVarIO (UsesOpen 0)
  action uses `finally` closeUses uses

withOperationUse :: OperationUses -> IO value -> IO (Either OperationUseError value)
withOperationUse (OperationUses source uses) action = mask $ \restore -> do
  admitted <- atomically $ do
    state <- readTVar uses
    case state of
      UsesOpen count -> writeTVar uses (UsesOpen (count + 1)) >> pure True
      UsesClosing _ -> pure False
  if admitted
    then restore run `finally` atomically (modifyTVar' uses release)
    else pure (Left OperationUseClosed)
 where
  ending = workEnd source
  run = do
    now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
    if now >= ending || ending - now < 1000
      then pure (Left OperationUseDeadlineReached)
      else do
        let micros = fromInteger (min (toInteger (maxBound :: Int)) (toInteger ((ending - now) `div` 1000)))
        attempted <- timeout micros $ do
          before <- verifySource source
          case before of
            Left cause -> pure (Left (OperationUseProcessRefused cause))
            Right () -> do
              value <- action >>= evaluate
              closing <- verifySource source
              pure (value <$ either (Left . OperationUseProcessRefused) Right closing)
        after <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
        pure $
          if after >= ending
            then Left OperationUseDeadlineReached
            else maybe (Left OperationUseDeadlineReached) id attempted
  release state = case state of
    UsesOpen count -> UsesOpen (count - 1)
    UsesClosing count -> UsesClosing (count - 1)

closeUses :: OperationUses -> IO ()
closeUses (OperationUses _ uses) = uninterruptibleMask_ $ do
  atomically (modifyTVar' uses beginClosing)
  atomically $ do
    state <- readTVar uses
    check $ case state of
      UsesOpen _ -> False
      UsesClosing count -> count == 0
 where
  beginClosing state = case state of
    UsesOpen count -> UsesClosing count
    UsesClosing count -> UsesClosing count

workEnd :: OperationUseSource -> Word64
workEnd source = case source of
  ParentUses processes -> hostExecutionWorkEnd (operationSubprocessWindow processes)
  TransportUses lease -> operationTransportWorkEnd lease

verifySource :: OperationUseSource -> IO (Either OperationSubprocessError ())
verifySource source = case source of
  ParentUses processes -> verifyOperationSubprocessesBeforeEffect processes
  TransportUses lease -> verifyOperationTransportBeforeEffect lease
